title: Naoki Azuma Launches New Glitch Witch Manga Set in Ghost in the Shell World
content: Naoki Azuma ( Keishichō Zōshi , Dragon & Ape ) launched on Kodansha 's YanMaga Web website on Wednesday a new manga titled GLITCH WITCH set in the world of Masamune Shirow 's Ghost in the Shell . Shirow is credited for the original concept. New chapters will update every other Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: Junket Bank TV Anime's Premiere Delayed from October
content: The anime was originally scheduled to premiere on TV Tokyo on October 5 at 12:00 a.m. JST (effectively, October 6). The story takes place in a world where banks serve as gambling halls.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Teases New Reveals for The Apothecary Diaries, Black Clover & More for NYCC 2026
content: Crunchyroll has also a huge slate of plans for the upcoming New York Comic Con 2026 this Fall, and they are teasing some new reveals for hits like The Apothecary Diaries, Black Clover , and more.
author: ComicBook

title: 29 Years Later, South Park Just Changed Its Name Ahead of New Season Premiere
content: South Park has undergone a surprise name change after 29 long years ahead of what is likely going to be a very wild season with Comedy Central. South Park made its full return to TV last year after some back and forth with Paramount over a new license deal for the franchise.
author: ComicBook

title: Broadcast of 'Junket Bank' Postponed
content: The official website of the Junket Bank anime series announced on Tuesday that the broadcast has been postponed indefinitely. The anime series adapted from Ikkou Tanaka 's Junket Bank gambling thriller manga was originally planned to premiere October 2026. A new broadcast date has yet to be announced.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Crunchyroll Reveals New York Comic Con 2026 Lineup With The Apothecary Diaries, Sentenced to Be a Hero, Black Clover and More
content: Crunchyroll has announced its New York Comic Con 2026 programming lineup, featuring panels, screenings and new announcements for titles including The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 , Black Clover Season 2 , Sentenced to Be a Hero and BLACK TORCH .
author: Anime Corner

title: Attack on Titan Returns With First Look at MAPPA’s Anime Comeback
content: Attack on Titan is officially celebrating its new holiday, and with it has offered a cool first look at MAPPA’s return to the anime franchise coming in a way you wouldn’t expect.
author: ComicBook

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Film Streams IMAX Trailer
content: TOHO began streaming on Tuesday a new 1.43:1 (the IMAX aspect ratio) trailer for Godzilla Minus Zero , the new Godzilla film from Godzilla Minus One 's Takashi Yamazaki : The sequel film will open in Japan on November 3.
author: ANN

title: Dandadan Creator Shares Their Wildest Crossover Yet Ahead of Season 3
